purpose: Concept previews only; no production code changes
prompts:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high fidelity, shippable Android mobile app UI design image for Huevia, a photography app. Input image 1 is the incumbent app screenshot, used as visual identity and content reference. Produce a flat front-on edge-to-edge portrait app screen, approximately 1080x2424; no phone hardware, perspective, external presentation board, decorative backdrop, captions, or watermark.
Preserve the incumbent warm paper #F8F7F4 background, white surfaces, charcoal #242420, warm gray secondary type, Chinese system sans typography and the same two-column masonry photo gallery with the SAME mountain lake, coffee, mountain valley, forest and portrait photographs. Real photographs dominate. Keep quiet thin consistent outline icons with round caps, roughly 24dp, exact equal optical size. No peach/orange primary fills, no yellow, no blue gradients, no glass blur. Keep familiar native Android status and gesture bars.
Show application album multi-select mode with exactly THREE selected photos: mountain lake, coffee, forest; charcoal circle with white check in the upper-right of those three, quiet hollow circles elsewhere. Preserve the application/phone source segmented control with exact labels "应用相册" and "手机相册", application selected. Keep date section "今天". The operation set is ONLY "编辑", "导出", "删除", cancel selection and select all. Deletion applies to application-album copies, no other invented features. Elegant restraint, balanced whitespace, reliable 48dp touch targets and no icon-label size jumps. All Chinese text must be crisp, exact, readable and not duplicated. The design needs to visibly solve a crowded bottom selection toolbar.
VARIANT A — compact contextual header + balanced bottom toolbar. Replace the selection-mode upper title area with a refined native contextual header: a thin close X at the left, "已选 3 张" in medium 18sp, and "全选" right aligned. Retain the source segmented control and gallery below it. Avoid repeating count/cancel in the bottom. At the bottom, replace the existing cramped action pill with ONE floating pure-white horizontal toolbar, softly rounded 24dp corners and very subtle neutral elevation, 16dp side margins and safe-area spacing. It contains EXACTLY THREE equally spaced actions, each a 24dp charcoal outline icon above a 12sp charcoal label: pencil "编辑", download-to-tray "导出", trash "删除". All three have equal visual size and weight, generous 28dp space between groups, no filled capsule behind a single action, no separator lines. Compact 76dp toolbar height. Three clean centered action groups, nothing else. The bottom main app navigation is hidden in selection mode. Prioritize the photo content. This is a calm, practical recommended design, not a promotional screen.
